description: Dataset manifest for OCEAN-X (OceanLens). Describes every dataset the backend depends on. Large scientific datasets are NOT committed to Git; see data/README.md for installation instructions.

datasets.name: IBTrACS_NI
datasets.purpose: Historical tropical cyclone best-track observations (North Indian Ocean) powering /cyclones, /hazards and /risk endpoints.
datasets.format: CSV (IBTrACS list format, 2 header rows: names + units)
datasets.source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), IBTrACS v04r01, North Indian Ocean basin
datasets.provenance_note: Real observations. Downloaded from NOAA NCEI. See backend/data/metadata/ibtracs.md.

datasets.name: ARGO_PROFILES_BOB
datasets.purpose: Processed Argo float in-situ temperature/salinity profiles for the Bay of Bengal, powering /argo endpoints.
datasets.source: Generated by backend/scripts/process_argo_bob.py from Argo GDAC (IFREMER ERDDAP)
datasets.provenance_note: Data status label 'REAL SOURCE — INGESTION PENDING'. The processed file currently contains a curated fallback profile set; see process_argo_bob.py for provenance details.

datasets.name: HYCOM_RSMC_RAW
datasets.purpose: Raw INCOIS RSMC HYCOM forecast fields used for depth-resolved Argo-vs-model matchups (/argo/{id}/matchup falls back to processed file when this is absent).
datasets.source: INCOIS Ocean State Forecast THREDDS server (RSMC HYCOM currents product)
datasets.size_note: approximately 10.58 GB (as reported by the THREDDS catalog dataSize)
datasets.manual_install: Place the file at backend/data/raw/ocean/currents/RSMC_hycom_20261008.nc. Use scripts/setup-data.py --download (resumable).
datasets.provenance_note: Real INCOIS RSMC HYCOM model output. The original source file must never be modified.
datasets.url_note: INCOIS rotates this forecast product and keeps only the most recent runs; the 20260908 run referenced by earlier revisions has been retired upstream. Bump the filename/download_url to a run present in https://incois.gov.in/thredds/catalog/osf/currents2/catalog.xml when re-installing.

datasets.name: HYCOM_BOB_SURFACE
datasets.purpose: Bay of Bengal surface extraction of the raw HYCOM file; primary dataset for /layers, /inspect, /timeseries, /observations and risk engine ocean fields.
datasets.manual_install: Run scripts/setup-data.py (or backend/scripts/extract_hycom_bob.py) after installing HYCOM_RSMC_RAW.
datasets.provenance_note: Derived product. Its metadata JSON (incois_hycom_bob_metadata.json, committed) records time range, region and variables.

datasets.name: HYCOM_BOB_SURFACE_METADATA
datasets.purpose: Committed metadata describing the generated HYCOM_BOB_SURFACE dataset; used by /status and /datasets endpoints.
datasets.provenance_note: Metadata only. Paths recorded inside are provenance records from generation time.

datasets.name: ARGO_RAW_INGESTION
datasets.purpose: Raw Argo ingestion payload kept for provenance/regeneration reference; not read at runtime.

datasets.name: TEST_FIXTURE_HYCOM_SURFACE
datasets.purpose: Synthetic schema-compatible NetCDF fixture for unit tests. NOT real scientific data.
datasets.provenance_note: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - contains constant/analytic placeholder values for schema and code-path testing only. Must never be used as real ocean data or substituted for production datasets at runtime.

datasets.name: TEST_FIXTURE_HYCOM_RAW
datasets.purpose: Synthetic schema-compatible fixture mirroring the raw HYCOM file (with DEPTH dimension) for unit tests. NOT real scientific data.
datasets.provenance_note: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - contains constant/analytic placeholder values for schema and code-path testing only. Must never be used as real ocean data or substituted for production datasets at runtime.

datasets.name: HYCOM_RSMC_RAW_SUBSETS
datasets.purpose: Archived Bay-of-Bengal NetCDFSubsets of every INCOIS RSMC HYCOM run currently published, so matchups can select the run whose time window covers an Argo profile. INCOIS deletes older runs.
datasets.format: NetCDF4 (CF-1.6 grid, cut with the INCOIS THREDDS NCSS service)
datasets.source: INCOIS Ocean State Forecast THREDDS server (RSMC HYCOM currents product)
datasets.provenance_note: Genuine INCOIS model output restricted to the Bay of Bengal by the publisher's own NetcdfSubset service; native depth axis, grid and time steps are unchanged. Never committed to Git.

categories.repository: Small files that are safe and necessary to commit to Git.
categories.local-scientific: Large datasets that must NOT be committed to Git; they remain on the local machine or are downloaded from the provider.
categories.generated: Files produced from source data by project scripts; not committed.
categories.test-fixture: Small synthetic files committed for tests. Clearly labeled; never real observations.

notes: No dataset in this manifest is fabricated scientific data. Test fixtures are labeled as synthetic and are used only for code-path/schema tests.
backend/data/raw/ocean/currents/ is intentionally empty in Git: the 9.85 GB HYCOM source file lives there only on machines where it was downloaded.
The committed metadata JSON in backend/data/processed/ocean/ describes the generated NetCDF that is not committed.
